name: Hall Pass
description: A red Ruby High hall pass that turns stepping out and returning ready into an ordinary part of learning.

name: Flashcards
description: A ring of handwritten study cards, revised often enough that the crossed-out answers have become useful too.

name: Library Card
description: A green Ruby High library card that carries the quiet promise that a better source may still be on the next shelf.

name: Lab Flask
description: A clean glass flask marked for observations first and guesses second.

name: Lunch Tray
description: A red cafeteria tray with enough room for lunch, a trade, and one rumor that should probably be checked.

name: Notebook
description: An open school notebook full of lists, diagrams, questions, and evidence that unfinished thoughts still count.
